status: exploratory source-only information audit designed after non-target source inspection; not preregistered before the V19BZ source outcome
purpose: Measure whether WALLABY moment-zero morphology alone can distinguish the blind SkyMapper candidate universe strongly enough to justify a hard optical-counterpart assignment, while retaining every candidate and keeping all kinematic and gravity targets sealed.

honesty_boundary.allowed_claim: reproducible exploratory measurement of source-side association information
honesty_boundary.forbidden_claim: prospective validation of a counterpart, galaxy split or gravity law

spatial_information_model.signal_image: clip the moment-zero map at zero so negative noise cannot act as counterpart evidence
spatial_information_model.beam_source: geometric mean of FITS BMAJ and BMIN
spatial_information_model.normalization: normalize every smoothed positive image to unit sum over its full FITS cutout
spatial_information_model.spatial_likelihood_ratio: sample the normalized image bilinearly at each candidate and divide by the uniform per-pixel density over the same cutout
spatial_information_model.support_distance: bilinear distance to the nearest nonzero moment-zero pixel, divided by the geometric-mean beam FWHM
spatial_information_model.ranking: descending spatial likelihood ratio with object_id ascending only as a deterministic tie break
spatial_information_model.optical_weight: none; extended_candidate is carried only as an unweighted diagnostic because SkyMapper DR4 extended-source photometry is not optimized

exploratory_information_sufficiency_rule.interpretation: A failure requires better source information or uncertainty propagation; it does not reject a gravity theory and cannot remove a galaxy.

claim_boundary: V19BZ measures how informative source-only H I/optical geometry is; it does not identify an optical counterpart.
All candidates and all Hydra TR1/TR2 alternatives remain in the outputs.
The margin grid is descriptive and the sufficiency rule is exploratory because source pixels were inspected before the protocol was written.
No candidate property is allowed to weight the spatial score, and no null prior or posterior is invented.
No velocity, rotation curve, lensing result, halo map, gravity residual, action, constant, holdout label or Solar-System result enters this audit.
